executionProtocol: Freeze a read-only pre-apply evidence snapshot and hash it.
Generate a candidate for exactly one wave from the revalidated manifest; do not hand-edit target values.
Run candidate in a transaction with fail-closed exact-value predicates and verify the expected affected-row count before commit.
After each committed wave, rerun target-level read-only reconciliation and the buyer-safe export summary.
Stop immediately on any unexpected row, source, count, rights-classification or publication-state drift.
Do not continue to the next wave until the prior wave has a complete rollback payload and post-wave evidence.
After all seven waves, regenerate the full buyer-safe export and final acquired-state evidence.

any target not represented in the reviewed manifest

postApplyAcceptance: 36/36 target rows reconcile to the reviewed proposed values.
34 published and 2 unpublished target split remains exact.
Hard-reference projection reconciles to 293 total / 290 published / 3 unpublished, or the change is treated as drift and investigated before any claim.
No replacement is claimed as whole-profile clearance or transfer-clear rights by itself.
Buyer-safe export remains SELECT-only and excludes personal/user-event data.
Final evidence records the exact applied wave commits/receipts, rollback payload hashes and post-apply counts.
claimBoundary: This artifact satisfies only the ordered-plan portion of G1-CB-14. It does not authorize or perform Production DML, does not close RT-007, and does not close G1.
